title: From ‘Folded’ to the Final Four: Kehlani to Headline Concert During 2026 NCAA Women’s Final Four
summary: Make sure to check the Grammy winner out next month in Phoenix for the free show.
contentText:
If you live in the Phoenix area or plan to travel there for this year’s NCAA Women’s Final Four, make sure to go check out Kehlani perform as she headlines the Super Saturday Concert.

AT&T is the presenting sponsor of the 2026 Women’s Final Four Super Saturday Concert in Phoenix featuring Grammy-winning singer Kehlani as the headliner. To celebrate March Madness and the Women’s Final Four tournament, AT&T is hosting a free concert in Hance Park on Saturday, April 4. AT&T customers can enjoy expedited entry through the AT&T Fast Lane.

“Headlining the Super Saturday Concert presented by AT&T during the Women’s Final Four is such an honor,” Kehlani says. “The dedication and spirit surrounding this weekend are incredible, and I’m looking forward to celebrating alongside the athletes and fans through music.”

According to the NCAA website , fans will need to show the AT&T icon on their phone screen at the concert entry point in order to access AT&T Fast Lane priority entry for AT&T customers and one guest. Fans must arrive at the main entry and be able to verify on their phone that AT&T is their wireless provider or have their AT&T Fiber bill ready for verification in order to take advantage of this expedited entry point. Just follow the signage and staff direction upon arrival to the AT&T Fast Lane to get your spot at the front of the line, and you’ll be able to enter the park grounds first once doors open.

The gates open at 6 p.m. MT, as DJ Javin hypes up the crowd until about 8 p.m. MT when Kehlani comes on. Entry will be free and they’ll have food and drinks available to purchase.

In other Kehlani news, the Bay Area singer took home her first Grammys in February when she won for best R&B performance and best R&B song for her hit record “Folded,” which has so far peaked at No. 6 on the Billboard Hot 100 and is a seven-week No. 1 on the R&B/Hip-Hop Airplay chart.
